exposure: mode of delivery (caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Perceived levels of autonomy in decision making
cohort: 1,402 women who received antenatal care and childbirth in Iceland between 2015-2021
finding: Migrant women, women with social complications, primiparous women, women with pregnancy complications, and those who gave birth by caesarean section reported lower levels of respectful care, while migrant women, women with social complications, and those who gave birth in a hospital setting reported lower levels of autonomy in decision making.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth by caesarean section reported lower levels of respectful care.
